title: Label changes rerun only the PR gates, not the full CI job
acceptance: Adding or removing a label (ready-to-merge, needs-owner, owner-approved) re-evaluates the owner gate without re-running install, tests, build and the e2e smoke, while the required check still reflects the gate result for the current head.
A label-only rerun can no longer turn a green PR red through a flaky e2e or cancel an in-flight run.
nextAction: Owner decides whether this is worth doing; then design a gate-only path (separate job or workflow on labeled/unlabeled) that keeps the required check name meaningful.

evidence.summary: Final review of #643 (finding 9): every label change reruns the whole ~5 minute job because the gate shares the required job; deferred by the owner on 2026-10-27.
